title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit — Workout Relief on a Late Fee
content:
When the borrower closes a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line to new draws while an amount is past due, Larkspur grants workout relief on one late fee of the line, booked as one courtesy fee-waiver entry against that late fee on the day it is granted and taken off the outstanding balance; the relief is never more than the fee it is booked against, and a relief that computes to 0.00 is still booked, as a 0.00 entry against that fee.

## Courtesy-waiver basis

A courtesy waiver of a late or returned-payment fee is granted on request when fewer than the tier's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the line; workout relief on a past-due line closed to new draws and replacement relief on the fee of a replaced returned payment are courtesy waivers Larkspur grants without a request, each under its own policy, still only while fewer than the tier's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the line.

A courtesy waiver the borrower asks for must be requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date; workout relief granted when a past-due line is closed to new draws, and only that relief, is not bound by that window.

## When the relief is fixed

Workout relief is fixed only after every due date whose minimum payment is still unpaid past the grace period carries its late-fee entry.

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Occasion | the borrower closes the line to new draws while an amount is past due |
| Request needed | no |
| Fees relieved | one late fee of the line |
| Entry | one courtesy fee-waiver entry against that late fee, dated the day it is granted |
| Effect | taken off the outstanding balance |
| Courtesy count | granted only while fewer than the tier's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the line |
| Request window | does not apply to this relief |
| Relief computing to 0.00 | still booked as a 0.00 entry against that fee |

## Relief tool: `grant_workout_fee_relief_903cc630`

**What it does.** Books one fee-waiver entry with the basis courtesy on the line, dated the current day and tied to the late fee it relieves, and takes the relief off the line's outstanding balance. The borrower sees the relief on the account and the lower balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `grant_workout_fee_relief_903cc630` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `credit_line_id` — reference number of the FlexLine, read from the FlexLine account lookup. Identifier.
- `related_txn_id` — reference number of the late-fee entry the relief is booked against, read from the FlexLine entry lookup for that line. Identifier.
- `relief_amount` — the relief granted, in USD as a decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; no currency sign.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `line_txn_id` (reference number of the new waiver entry), `related_txn_id` (the fee it is booked against), `amount` (the relief, USD with 2 decimal places), `waiver_reason` (courtesy) and `outstanding_balance` (the balance after the relief, USD with 2 decimal places). The new `line_txn_id` confirms the relief was booked.
